detail.longDescription:
Freebuff brings AI chat and coding agents to your iPhone and iPad. Ask questions about code, explore ideas, and work on your own GitHub repositories in cloud coding sessions.

• Chat with AI models and choose a model for your task.
• Start coding sessions against your repositories in a cloud sandbox.
• Follow conversations and continue work across Freebuff surfaces.
• Manage your account, usage, and settings in the app.

Freebuff includes an ad-supported free allowance. Existing Freebuff plan benefits are available when you sign in. Available models and usage allowances depend on your account and current service availability.
